name: action-button
title: Action button
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A compact button that moves through pending and success after an async action.

meta.descriptionEs: Un botón compacto que pasa por pendiente y éxito después de una acción.

examples.title: Botón de acción
examples.description: Un botón compacto que pasa por pendiente y éxito después de una acción.

api.name: onAction
api.description: Runs the action. The button stays pending until it settles.

api.name: resetAfterMs
api.description: How long success stays before the label returns.

api.name: onActionError
api.description: Called when the action rejects. The button returns to idle.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
